Now guys, when I was at coin market cap, I went over to the trending section as a lot of you might and I saw Dogecoin is actually up 15.69% and I was like, hold on. This is a pretty massive pump for one of the biggest meme coins in the world if not the biggest one and dogecoin is literally pumping hard you can see the amount of volume that has come in in the last 24 hours it's up 100 percent and that's all because of you know you know of the connection that dogecoin has to elon musk and there wasn't a direct mention of dogecoin but people assumed this indirectly meant that dogecoin is going to get some pretty crazy utility you can see that this is wiped out all the losses on the week and the weekly it is up 14 now in the month still down about 20 guys but in the last 24 hours up 15.71 now sitting at just under 20 billion dollar market cap let's take a look at the community over here doge is pumping hard it's been a while since i seriously looked at doge though maybe this is a sign now what do you guys need to understand is guys it is so easy for something like dogecoin to pump especially when elon musk is um is backing it right we've all known elon musk to be the guy that loves dogecoin because especially from the last bull run the biggest reason dogecoin did so well is because of twitter and because of elon musk and his influence i mean i literally remember selling my dogecoin too early and i've seen like the skits on snl i've seen just how hard dogecoin pumped and guys the amount of dogecoin that i was holding i was literally able to make over 100 x but i sold too early and hey a bittersweet moment but it's good to see dogecoin pumping here again you love to see it guys um if you go over to the x account over here make sure you guys are up to date with Dogecoin because, hey, I don't have to tell you that we're 5 million followers. But what is the reason that they are pumping? Well, because of this right here. You never know! 2 Elon, here's why x will surpass 1 billion daily active users. And every single time you've heard, you've heard people say Bitcoin is dead, Bitcoin is dying. Just remember this chart over here. Every time somebody has said that, if you were to have just bought $ hundred dollars worth of bitcoin you would be up over 72 million dollars today bitcoin is not going anywhere bitcoin is a code and it's an algorithm and if you guys know the cycles if you study the cycles then you know it follows a very simple sheet here I've made a video about this as well that you guys can check out when I think the bitcoin low will come in and if that is something that you guys are interested in check the link in my description for more information about all the different cryptos that i hold i'll see you guys next time thank you so much for watching don't try family subscribe hit the bell if you haven't already and i'll see you guys next time thanks for watching god bless you jesus loves you i love you y'all take care peace out y'all
